pr_title: chore: migrate builtin reporters to ReporterV2
pr_body:
This allows builtin reporters to handle stdio between onConfigure and onBegin.

Fixes #23539.

issue_context.title: [BUG] WebServer stdout and stderr "pipe" does not stream output
issue_context.body:
[BUG] WebServer stdout and stderr "pipe" does not stream output as per the documentation which makes debugging impossible.

### System info
- Playwright Version: 1.34.3
- Operating System: osx
- Browser: All
- Other info:

### Source code

- [X] I provided exact source code that allows reproducing the issue locally.

https://github.com/andrewmclagan/playwright-std-out

```
pnpm test:e2e
```

You will notice output is only displayed _**after**_ the web-server's URL is reachable and is not streamed/piped to `stdout` as per the configuration setting. This makes it very difficult to debug when the web-server has a possible long startup, or there are errors. Forcing the developer to wait for the `webServer.timeout`
comments: Investigation note: Issue is that we defer the stdout/stderr events until onBegin was fired: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/dd9a49690b2d93da2a068a53ea891896810caafb/packages/playwright-test/src/reporters/internalReporter.ts#L47-L61

Okay that makes sense.

**Side Note** It could also be helpful to prefix `stdout` and `stderr` with a property of the `config.webServer[]` otherwise when starting multiple processes the output is ambiguous. I guess this would require an optional `config.webServer[].name: string` perhaps defaulting to `config.webServer[].index: number`.

@andrewmclagan I'm still running into this issue. I can't get the `stdout` from my webserver.  Here's a [repo example](https://github.com/adueck/haskell-mailer/tree/8eff8ef0b3c9c6a0131083d10386c7ccb62350c6)
 Nothing comes out from the `stdout` from my webserver. The only `stdout` that shows up is when I run an `execSync` to call some command in the test.

review_comments: Why do we have these, aren't they optional?
